profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at DocuSign
profile.summary:
8+ years of professional experience working as a software engineer. Capable of leading initiatives that span across multiple months.

I truly enjoy learning new technologies, as a result, I have many side projects that I actively work on. Currently, my interests align heavily with microservices architecture that make use of containers to solve day to day problems. 

I like working with complex data structures and fast paced environment that involves the usage of SCRUM/Agile methodologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Implemented throttling for public endpoints as a full stack engineer on the Real Estate API team
• Triaged and resolved bugs in the team backlog, driving the number of bugs by 40%
• Act as team scrum master for a group of 5 engineers by ensuring tasks are up to date, and hosting daily standups and retrospectives to improve team communication
• Mentor 3 engineers to teach best code practices and set up developer local environments
• Interview interns and fulltime software engineers 2-3 times a week

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed code using C# and Elasticsearch on the Data Grid platform
• Assisted with feature development and write testable code
• Tested and deployed code with CI/CD pipelines through Jenkins and TeamCity
• Enabled existing code into Jenkins to perform automated nightly tests
• Implemented New Relic metrics to push and monitor application health
• Reviewed other developers' pull requests on BitBucket
• Applied optimizations to legacy code while fixing defects

positions.title: Computer Specialist
positions.description:
• IT tech support to users on Windows, OSX, Linux, Android, iOS, and Windows Phone
• Day to day operations including maintenance of common machines
• Maintained stock by determining current stock and forecasting future needs

positions.title: Business Technology Intern
positions.description:
• Mobile application development using React Native
• Developed full fledged production ready features
• Wrote unit tests using Jest Framework
• Tested and deployed code through Travis CI
• Reviewed other developers' pull requests on Github

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Assisted with the migration of Sharepoint 2010 to Sharepoint 2016
•	Constructed and integrated custom web parts using Javascript, jQuery, CSS, HTML
•	Developed code to create, delete, update, and populate Lists using restfulAPI 
•	Applied personalization using Search Rest API
•	Leveraged jQuery and Javascript to eliminate frequent page re-load

positions.title: Group Leader
positions.description:
•	Assigned/Handed out work to 7-9 people everyday
•	Set up machines for production and fix them as necessary
•	Conducted multiple tests throughout the day to ensure the quality of products
•	Helped create a friendly environment among employees
•	Solved interpersonal conflicts between employees

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Helped create a user interface for an ecology simulator used in urban planning meetings
•	Designed and created a drag and drop interface using iOS programming and Objective-C
•	Read, analyzed, and used data inside the application
•	Conducted a usability study to measure the efficiency of different user interface implementations

positions.title: Manager/Pro Sandwich Artist
positions.description:
Some of the responsibilities I had at Subway were:
• Help the store increase sales.
• Making sure everything worked efficiently.
• Solve any inner conflicts between employees.
• Keeping track of inventory and restock it accordingly.
• Develop a friendly and welcoming environment.
• Solve any disputes customers had and work with them until they were satisfied.

positions.title: Pro Sandwich Artist
positions.description:
As a Pro Sandwich Artist, I was responsible for:
• Meeting the weekly deadlines that were set by the manager.
• Making sure everything were up to standard.
• Working with other coworkers to help ensure everything is done correctly.

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Helped raise over $100,000 to pay for schools in rural India.
• Help manage sitting for over 1000 people.
• Help out in the kitchen to serve food.

projects.title: Delta Case Study - Innovation Project
projects.description:
The challenge of the innovation contest was to compete against the other intern teams from New York and Seattle, and innovate using the existing Avanade Mobile Airline Platform to come up with a solution for an airline. 

Result: The Chicago team (aka, the other interns and I) came in first place.

projects.title: CTA "L" Ridership Analysis
projects.description:
link to github: https://github.com/jppateljay1/cta_ridership_analysis

The project was made using Visual Studios and created with C++14. It analyzes data from CTA's famous "L" trains.
